M1.fit: closed-form least squares, pooled over the training runs' shelf cells (uniform grid = area-weighted)

M2.fit: closed-form least squares, pooled over the training runs' shelf cells (uniform grid = area-weighted)

M3.fit: closed-form least squares, pooled over the training runs' shelf cells (uniform grid = area-weighted)

M4.selection: inner leave-one-run-out over the fit's runs, mean rmse_map, ties -> linear

M5.sigma: EOF propagation of independent coefficient variances; truncation error not added

M6.validation_rule: per member (R10, R12): one run drawn at random at each of the Tbot levels [highest, levels[(L - 1) // 2], lowest] with np.random.default_rng([split_seed, member_seed]); fewer than n_val + 1 runs -> highest level only; validation runs excluded from gradients, standardiser, y_scale and K0
M6.stopping: mean rmse_map over the member's validation runs; stop after patience epochs without improvement; best weights restored

M7.validation_rule: per member (R10, R12): one run drawn at random at each of the Tbot levels [highest, levels[(L - 1) // 2], lowest] with np.random.default_rng([split_seed, member_seed]); fewer than n_val + 1 runs -> highest level only; validation runs excluded from gradients, standardiser, y_scale and K0
M7.stopping: mean rmse_map over the member's validation runs; stop after patience epochs without improvement; best weights restored
M7.variance: sigma_m^2 = softplus(h0(x_g))^2 + (softplus(h1(x_g)) stopgrad(mu_m))^2 + var_floor (ruling R11; heads see x_g only)
M7.form: m = K b^n g_theta(x_g); b = TF+ (local) or (TF+ |<TF>|)^(1/2) (nonlocal, R3); K, n trainable per member
M7.K0_rule: K0 = coef * c^2 of the closed-form M2 (local) or M3 (nonlocal) fit on the member's training runs
M7.tf_kind_rule: inner CV by run: tf_kind_folds groups (None = one per run) from np.random.default_rng(split_seed + 1).permutation; criterion mean rmse_map over held-out runs; tie -> local

thresholds.hypothesis_folds: H3a-H3c use the main folds only; drop_n1 results are sensitivity

H3a.rule: mean over the 3 runs: M7 < M6, and M7 < M6 in >= 2 of the 3 runs

H3b.cases: leave-one-run-out (25 main folds, not the drop_n1 sensitivity folds)

H3c.cases: zc_out + warm_out test runs + final test runs, for M6 and M7
H3c.spread: std (ddof = 0) over the 5 members of the integrated melt / |integrated melt of the ensemble mean| (Ockenden et al. 2026)
H3c.rule: no case with spread < spread_max AND |integrated_rel_error| > error_min

thresholds.noise_floor_rule: a difference between methods smaller than the pooled noise RMS (rmse_map, rmse_gl) or than the median |N1 drift| (integrated_rel_error) is not interpreted
thresholds.stop_rule: --cv: if the wall-clock estimate (<= 5 concurrent processes, 1 thread each, measured after the first batch of folds) exceeds 8 h, stop and report
thresholds.stop_rule_note: limit raised from the plan's 6 h to 8 h by Esteban (2026-11-10), before any protocol run, because full-LORO tf_kind selection puts the estimate at about 6 h
